posts.title: London Seirei Tanteidan (Playstation)
posts.description: The first thing that'll hit you when you start playing this game (which is also known as London Spirit Detectives) is how visually beautiful it is. Rather than using tile-based maps like most 2D RPGs, every area is instead a big, handcrafted unique piece of pixel art (with a few minor exceptions, like the bits of steam machinery seen in various locations that I think are copy-pasted sprites). Maki
